name: Washibuchi Gonzou
source:
Washibuchi 'Eagle' Gonzou is a third year student in the general education curriculum of Ryouzuki school. He transferred to Masaru's class during the beginning of the game, and he's a huge guy with a funny countryside accent and somewhat anarchistic appearance - a diagonally worn school cap with a crack in front, wooden clogs and unshaven face. According to him, "he came to Tokyo for the sake of becoming a better, manlier man".

He fell in love at first sight with Masaru's little sister, Shouko. From then on, he too starts worshipping Masaru, hanging out with him. Contrary to his scary face, he is quite clever, naive and has a strong sense of justice.

Gonzou's father is a wealthy politician in Tokyo, and is a big-shot member of the National Diet who is being rumored to become the next prime minister. Gonzou's ambition is to succeed after his dad.
